title: windows: eliminate a start-up race between two dependent services
scenario: On windows, a hard operational problem: Un servizio parte a volte si', a volte no, a seconda dell'ordine con un altro servizio (race non deterministica). Rendi l'avvio deterministico. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: eliminate a start-up race between two dependent services

initial_state: # fixture: windows host prepared for 'eliminate a start-up race between two dependent services'
expected_reasoning: Nondeterministic start = an unexpressed ordering/readiness dependency, a race.
Identify the real readiness condition (port open / socket / health), not just 'process started'.
Express the dependency as readiness (socket activation / wait-for) so ordering is deterministic.
expected_commands: # windows-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: eliminate a start-up race between two dependent services
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'eliminate a start-up race between two dependent services' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: eliminate a start-up race between two dependent services

possible_mistakes: Add a fixed sleep and call it fixed.
hints: A sleep is a race with a timer, not a fix.
alternative_solution: Use a health-gated proxy so dependents only connect when ready.
edge_cases: The dependency is ready-ish but not fully warmed, so it flaps.
